heading_path: 7.4  Notice of renewal due—when and how given
text: (1) For the purposes of section 76 of the Act (which deals with notice of renewal due), the period in relation to notifying a registered owner that renewal of the registration of a trade mark is due is 2 months ending on the day on which the registration of the trade mark expires. (2) A notice that the renewal is due must include: (a) a statement of the date on which the registration of the trade mark will expire; and (b) a statement of any fee payable.
